entry.title: Optimal Execution and Adverse Selection in Hawkes-Driven Limit Order Books with Rough Volatility
entry.summary:
Classical Almgren-Chriss execution assumes Brownian price impact and Poisson order flow, underestimating tail slippage during liquidity droughts. Modeling mutually exciting order arrivals via a bivariate Hawkes process coupled with fractional Hurst exponent $H \approx 0.12$, we derive closed-form Riccati execution schedules that cut implementation shortfall by $19.4\text{ bps}$.

Source: arXiv Quantitative Finance (q-fin.TR) · Tags: #quant-finance #market-design #probability-stats

entry.title: Sharp Non-Asymptotic Generalization Bounds for LoRA Fine-Tuning Under Heavy-Tailed Gradients
entry.summary:
Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) empirically resists overfitting even when fine-tuned on small domain corpora with high gradient variance. We derive non-asymptotic PAC-Bayes generalization bounds scaling with the stable rank $\text{sr}(BA) \ll r$, explaining why rank-$16$ adapters match full fine-tuning sample complexity.

Source: JMLR / stat.ML · Tags: #ml-theory #llm #probability-stats

entry.title: Global Regularity for Fractional Navier-Stokes Equations Below the Lions Exponent
entry.summary:
Whether smooth solutions to the 3D incompressible Navier-Stokes equations with fractional dissipation $(-\Delta)^\alpha u$ remain regular below $\alpha = 5/4$ is a long-standing open problem. Using quantitative De Giorgi-Nash-Moser oscillation decay along space-time vorticity filaments, we prove global $C^\infty$ regularity for $\alpha > 5/4 - \varepsilon_0$.

Source: arXiv Mathematics (math.AP) · Tags: #analysis-pde #probability-stats
